name: mailcraft-monorepo
description: MailCraft – No-login promotional email creation and delivery platform

scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared-types build && pnpm --filter validation build && pnpm --filter email-renderer build && pnpm --filter database build && pnpm --filter email-providers build && pnpm --filter worker build && pnpm --filter web build
